note: Mechanical interface of the custom boards (build/15: three boards + the encoder daughterboard that STACK 5.8 requires to be replaceable). Board coordinates: origin at the lower-left corner of the board outline as seen from the component side; mm. place.origin = enclosure coordinates of that corner; place.z_bottom = z of the board face opposite the components; place.facing = direction the component side faces (+z towards the front face, -z towards the rear wall). Only the mechanical interface is defined here; routing, footprints and Gerbers belong to the PCB work (pcb/).

stackup._t_note: W2 MECH-8: t is computed, not ordered. The JLC06161H-2116 layer table (https://jlcpcb.com/impedance, read 2026-11-13: top copper 0.035, prepreg 2116x1 0.127, 2313x1 0.0964, L2 copper 0.0152, core 0.3, L3 copper 0.0152, 7628x1 0.2084, 7628x1 0.2084, L4 copper 0.0152, core 0.3, L5 copper 0.0152, 2313x1 0.0964, 2116x1 0.127, bottom copper 0.035; 6-layer options 'Outer Copper Weight: 1oz 2oz', 'Inner Copper Weight: 0.5oz 1oz 2oz') sums to 1.5944 mm; with 0.070 mm finished outer foil (2 oz, https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities, read 2026-11-13: 'Multi-layer: 1 oz / 2 oz') it is 1.6644 mm, used as 1.664 (MODEL). CTRL._zones_note: computed by srrx_mech.boards.clearance_map (W2 MECH-1, MODEL ESTIMATE): free_mm = free height from the component face (height_zones) or the back face (rear_zones) to the nearest layout envelope, structure part, button-cap flange or shell wall; fits_mm = free_mm - 0.5; max_height stays the envelope limit the model uses for the whole board (layout.board_boxes), so a taller part in a zone needs a per-zone envelope first; mechanical/tests keep these lists equal to the computation (after a layout change: python mechanical/build.py --update-zones)

edge_zones.use: harness to the power board and Pico/IMU links (JST PH 2.0)
JST PH to the two ENC daughterboards

CTRL.notes: TL3145BF350QJ switches face the front wall; caps 12 mm, 22 mm pitch (mechanical.json hmi.buttons). Harness headers: JST PH side entry only (4.8 mm, JST ePH), 16-pin groups as 2 x 8 (S16B-PH-K-S not stocked); the height of the IDC box XDFH-0254-2*20P (S01) and of the vertical Micro-Fit 43650 headers against max_height 5.5 is not read (TBD, fit-report board_area).
CTRL._outline_note: top-right corner chamfered to clear the rounded inner corner of the shells (R 11.5)

ENC.name: encoder daughterboard (PEC11R-4220F-S0024), same design x2 + 1 spare

ENC.notes: PEC11R rear-facing pins (type 4); bushing M7x0.75 through the 2.6 mm boss with an O-ring (STACK 5.8). pcb/prepare.py domain ENC (ENC301/ENC302); harness S37/S38 to CTRL with side-entry JST PH.

small_boards._note: boards of pcb/prepare.py that are not mounted on the plate or the front shell: their envelope is a layout item (or the IMU pack) and their layout is wave 2 (W2-05); listed here so the board domains of the partition are all accounted for
